dimensions.assessment: Affects the Saint Regis Mohawk Tribe, the Mohawk Council of Akwesasne, the State of New York, specific New York counties and towns, and the New York Power Authority.
dimensions.evidence: entered into by the Saint Regis Mohawk Tribe, the Mohawk Council of Akwesasne, the State of New York, the Counties of Franklin and Saint Lawrence, New York, the Towns of Fort Covington and Bombay, New York, and the New York Power Authority.

dimensions.assessment: Restores land rights, provides educational assistance, requires annual financial payments, and alters jurisdictional status of specified lands.
dimensions.evidence: restores land rights and provides access to land to SRMT, provides tuition assistance for tribal members to certain postsecondary institutions, and requires the New York Power Authority to make annual payments to SRMT.

dimensions.assessment: Involves financial terms such as annual payments from the New York Power Authority and tuition assistance, though federal spending amounts are not specified in the text.
dimensions.evidence: requires the New York Power Authority to make annual payments to SRMT.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes, ratifies, and confirms a comprehensive multi-party settlement agreement and changes the legal status of specific lands to Indian country.
dimensions.evidence: The following shall be Indian Country as defined in section 1151(a) of title 18, United States Code... Land owned on the effective date of the Settlement Agreement by the Saint Regis Mohawk Tribe

dimensions.assessment: Provides permanent settlement terms, land status changes, and ongoing annual payment obligations.

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts of annual payments and tuition assistance.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill ratifies a settlement agreement resolving the Akwesasne Mohawk land claim in New York, affects local jurisdictions and the Saint Regis Mohawk Tribe, and designates certain tribal lands as Indian country.
